matchById.recapBody: [{"type":"header","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Los Angeles completes comeback in OT, clinches playoff spot"}],"style":"h2","format":{"text-align":" center"}},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Trailing 4-0 on the 12"},{"type":"text","value":"th","format":{"variants":["superscript"]}},{"type":"text","value":" tee, and with a 2 percent chance to win the match, Los Angeles Golf Club roared back to top New York Golf Club in Overtime and lock up a playoff spot with the most improbable comeback victory in TGL presented by SoFi history."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"The 5-4 victory guarantees Los Angeles will finish inside the top four in the SoFi Cup Standings and couldn’t have come in more dramatic fashion."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Sahith Theegala got the rally started with a 28-foot birdie putt at the 12"},{"type":"text","value":"th","format":{"variants":["superscript"]}},{"type":"text","value":" to make it 4-1 and keep his team alive over the final three holes. "}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Tony Finau, joining LAGC on a one-match contract with Justin Rose and Tommy Fleetwood both unavailable, stepped up to the par-4 13"},{"type":"text","value":"th","format":{"variants":["superscript"]}},{"type":"text","value":" after Los Angeles threw the Hammer to make the hole worth two points."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"With even more pressure on the new guy, Finau hit his approach to nine feet for a birdie putt with a chance to cut the deficit to one. After wisely letting the shot clock run down before calling timeout, Los Angeles got a great read and Finau drained the putt to make it 4-3 with two holes to play. "}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"“It feels like a college basketball game right now,” Theegala said. “You know you’re gonna get on runs. You just gotta wait for your time.”"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"It was Collin Morikawa’s time to make his move at the 14"},{"type":"text","value":"th","format":{"variants":["superscript"]}},{"type":"text","value":", hitting his tee shot to six feet at the par-3, Set in Stone, and draining the birdie putt to tie the match and cap a furious three-hole rally."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Los Angeles moved into first place outright with seven total points in the SoFi Cup Standings and became the first team to lock up a postseason spot. The Bay also became postseason eligible via the New York defeat."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"The all-out blitz spoiled a record-setting performance from New York, which came up short in the first two rounds of Overtime. "}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Rickie Fowler set a TGL record for the longest putt made with his 36-foot birdie on the first hole, only to be outdone by a 38-footer from Cameron Young on the fourth."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Matt Fitzpatrick faced another pressure-packed putt at the eighth, with New York leading 3-0 but facing a potential two-point swing after accepting a Hammer throw from Los Angeles. Fitzpatrick stepped up and made a huge 10-footer for par to tie the hole."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Finau announced his presence in style on the first hole, doing a dance on the back box before getting his tee shot off just a second ahead of the buzzer – a nod to LAGC co-owner Serena Williams, who knocked out a similar dance at the Super Bowl halftime show and was in attendance Monday at SoFi Center on the campus of Palm Beach State College."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"The six-time PGA Tour winner was definitely soaking up the vibes – he was seen Face Timing one of his kids from the floor of SoFi Center during warm-ups and said he’s been keeping tabs on the league all season. "}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"“I’m so impressed with the place,” Finau said. “I couldn’t believe how big it was. I watched a lot of the matches ... It’s really cool to finally be here.”"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"It’s safe to say he made the most of the moment in the first match of a doubleheader, with pro athletes like former New York Giants quarterback Eli Manning and Super Bowl champion Philadelphia Eagles cornerback Avonte Maddox and tight end Dallas Goedert looking on."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"New York remains in fourth place and is still alive in the postseason race having earned one point with the Overtime loss."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Los Angeles still has plenty at stake as it fights for the top seed its next time out at 3 p.m. ET on March 3 against The Bay Golf Club as part of a doubleheader. "}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"New York returns to action for its final match in the second half of the March 3 doubleheader, taking on Boston Common Golf at 7 p.m. ET."}]}]
